clue.text: Deeply moved in a pretentious way

definitions.meaning: showy and artificial in manner, putting on airs

explanation.surface: Someone is moved, but the display of emotion seems put on.
explanation.definitionFit: The word has two senses: emotionally stirred, and artificial or put on for show.

clue.text: Shocked by silver headwear about Susie's head

parts.note: Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

indicators.note: about means going around, so the hat is placed around the next letter

parts.note: a hat is a piece of headwear

indicators.note: the head of the name Susie is its opening letter

explanation.surface: Someone is horrified by a silver hat perched on Susie's head.
explanation.walkthrough: 'by' looks like it means 'shocked by'; it is only a link, and 'head' picks the opening letter of Susie for 'about' to wrap.
explanation.definitionFit: Being horrified or appalled is being shocked.

clue.text: Weakness of being upset by nasty bile

indicators.note: in a down clue, upset means turned upside down, so the little word of is read bottom to top
nasty suggests the letters of bile are spoiled and rearranged

explanation.surface: A medical-sounding complaint: a fragility caused by being upset by bad bile.
explanation.walkthrough: 'being upset' turns OF into FO; 'nasty' rearranges BILE into IBLE. The OCR text reads 'if', but the wordplay needs 'of'.
explanation.definitionFit: A foible is a minor flaw or failing of character.

clue.text: Taxi I catch for some senior politicians

parts.note: a cab is a taxi
to net something is to catch it

explanation.surface: Someone hails a cab to catch a group of top politicians.
explanation.definitionFit: The group of senior ministers who run a government is collectively called by this name.

clue.text: Touches headless fish

indicators.note: headless says the opening letter of the word is cut off

parts.note: feels means touches

explanation.surface: Someone touches fish that have had their heads removed.
explanation.definitionFit: These are long, snake-like fish, and fish can be plural.

clue.text: Clues like this make leading Anglican angry

indicators.note: leading picks the front letter of the word Anglican

parts.note: cross means angry

explanation.surface: Something about these clues makes a senior Anglican churchman furious.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is self-referential: this clue is itself one of the horizontal clues in the grid.
explanation.definitionFit: This clue sits in the horizontal list, so it is one of those clues.

clue.text: It can be played about the office? That's right!

parts.note: c, short for circa, means about
the offices is an old euphemism for the lavatory, so the office is a lav
i.e., Latin id est, means that is

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether the thing is played about the office and is told yes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the office' as a euphemism for the toilet is a British usage, giving LAV.
explanation.definitionFit: This is an old keyboard instrument, such as a harpsichord, which a musician plays.

clue.text: First sailor leaving concerned with Australian

indicators.note: leaving says the sailor departs from the longer word

parts.note: Aboriginal describes things concerned with the native peoples of Australia
AB, able seaman, is a sailor

explanation.surface: The first sailor departs from a matter involving an Australian.
explanation.walkthrough: 'First' looks like an adjective on 'sailor', but it is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Original means earliest, the very first of its kind.

clue.text: Banner put right in ship

indicators.note: in says the letter for right goes inside the ship

parts.note: a steamer is a ship

explanation.surface: A banner is placed correctly on board a ship.
explanation.definitionFit: A long narrow flag or ribbon flown as a banner is this.

clue.text: One might make a Persian gag?

definitions.text: One might make a Persian gag?

parts.words: One might make a Persian gag?
parts.note: a Persian is a long-haired cat, and grooming leaves a wad of fur that makes such a cat retch, not a joke from Iran

explanation.surface: Something might produce a joke from Persia.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Persian' suggests Iran and 'gag' a joke; really it is the cat and choking.
explanation.definitionFit: Cats swallow fur when grooming, which clumps and makes them choke and cough it up.

clue.text: Cook vicar a posh meal

indicators.note: to cook figures is to rework them, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone is told to prepare a grand meal for the vicar.
explanation.definitionFit: Sturgeon roe is a luxury food, a byword for posh eating.

clue.text: A purest sort of chemist

indicators.note: sort of signals a version of the words, so their letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A chemist of the purest kind.
explanation.walkthrough: Louis Pasteur was the French chemist behind pasteurisation.
explanation.definitionFit: The French scientist Louis Pasteur was trained as a chemist and microbiologist.

clue.text: Girl in a briny marsh

parts.note: Sal is a girl's name, short for Sally or Sarah
taken as written

explanation.surface: A girl is standing in a salt marsh.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' looks like a link placing the girl in the marsh, but it supplies its own letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A salina is a salt marsh or salt pan.

clue.text: Graduate with quartz church

parts.note: BA, Bachelor of Arts, is a graduate
quartz is a crystalline form of silica

explanation.surface: A graduate turns up with a lump of quartz at church.
explanation.definitionFit: A basilica is a large, oblong church given special status.

clue.text: Name a perfume coming into existence

parts.note: scent is perfume

explanation.surface: Someone names a new perfume that is just being launched.
explanation.definitionFit: Nascent means just beginning to develop.

clue.text: Take a starter put out before this?

definitions.text: Take a starter put out before this?

indicators.note: put out means disturbed or displaced, so the letters of these three words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A diner is told to take a starter served before the main dish.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is the definition too: a raw-beef dish often served as a starter, before the main course.
explanation.definitionFit: This raw minced-beef dish is often served as a first course, the starter itself.

clue.text: When in continent doctor's right to love delicious food

indicators.note: in says the doctor, right and love go inside the continent

parts.note: Asia is a continent
MB, Bachelor of Medicine, is a doctor
love is nil in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: When abroad, a doctor has the right to love fine food.
explanation.definitionFit: The food of the Greek gods, now used of anything delicious to eat.

clue.text: College has poem after all

parts.note: uni, university, is a college
verse is poetry, a poem

explanation.surface: A college has a poem after all.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after all' reads as a phrase meaning 'in the end', but 'all' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Everything that exists, the cosmos, is the whole of creation.

clue.text: Made mud at furnace pots

indicators.note: to pot is to shape into pots, so the letters are worked into a new form

explanation.surface: Pots are made from mud fired at a furnace.
explanation.definitionFit: Manufactured means made, produced industrially.

clue.text: Permanently pro-benefit

parts.note: pro means in favour of, for
good means benefit, as in for your own good

explanation.surface: A slogan backing welfare payments for ever.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means for ever, never to change.

clue.text: Put up with bricks and mortar

definitions.text: Put up with bricks and mortar

parts.words: Put up with bricks and mortar
parts.note: put up reads as tolerated, but here it means built, raised with bricks and mortar

explanation.walkthrough: 'Put up with' looks like 'tolerated'; it is 'put up', built, followed by the materials.
explanation.definitionFit: A building raised or constructed has been put up.

clue.text: Aims to turn red

indicators.note: turn means spin around, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone sets out to become a communist.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to' is part of the fodder, not a link: AIMSTO is rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: A follower of Chairman Mao is a communist, a red.

clue.text: It's a thin slice but a good deal, maybe

definitions.text: It's a thin slice but a good deal, maybe

parts.words: It's a thin slice but a good deal, maybe
parts.note: deal is cheap pine wood, so a thin slice of fine wood glued over deal makes it look good; the surface suggests a bargain

explanation.walkthrough: 'a good deal' reads as a bargain; deal is softwood, and a fine-wood facing covers it.
explanation.definitionFit: A thin layer of fine wood glued over cheaper timber gives a good-looking surface.

clue.text: Having respect and always in charge

indicators.note: in says the word for always sits inside the charge

parts.note: rent is a charge paid for use of property
ever means always

explanation.surface: A respectful person who is always in command.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in charge' reads as one phrase meaning in command; 'charge' is RENT.
explanation.definitionFit: Showing deep respect is being reverent.

clue.text: Live on own and conduct oneself well

parts.note: to be is to live, to exist
to have is to own

explanation.surface: Someone lives alone and keeps good manners.
explanation.definitionFit: Behaving is acting properly, minding one's manners.

clue.text: Muslim's open land

definitions.meaning: a North African Muslim of medieval Spain
a stretch of uncultivated upland such as heath

explanation.surface: A Muslim owns a stretch of open land.
explanation.definitionFit: One word names a medieval North African Muslim and a stretch of wild heathland.

clue.text: Address of a church?

parts.note: address reads as a street location, but here it is a speech delivered in church

explanation.walkthrough: 'Address' suggests a postal location; it means a speech, one given from the pulpit.
explanation.definitionFit: The talk a preacher gives in church is an address to the congregation.

clue.text: Prisoner takes time with short banker to plan

parts.note: con, short for convict, is a prisoner

indicators.note: short means the word is cut by its last letter

parts.note: a river has banks, so in crosswords it is a banker

explanation.surface: A prisoner serves time with a crooked banker, who is short, to plot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'banker' is a crossword joke: a river has banks; 'short' removes the R from RIVER.
explanation.definitionFit: To contrive something is to devise or scheme it.

clue.text: A lawyer holds info on things to discuss

indicators.note: holds means the letters for info are kept inside the A and lawyer

parts.note: DA, District Attorney, is an American lawyer
gen is slang for information

explanation.surface: A lawyer keeps information on the topics up for discussion.
explanation.walkthrough: GEN is British slang for information.
explanation.definitionFit: An agenda is the list of items for a meeting.

clue.text: Hunter of "Teardrop Explode"

indicators.note: explode means blow apart, so the letters of the word are scattered and reassembled

explanation.surface: A hunter linked to a band called Teardrop Explode.
explanation.walkthrough: The Teardrop Explodes was a 1980s British band.
explanation.definitionFit: A predator is an animal that hunts others.
